notes.title: Be My Valentine Giveaway!
notes.notes: Hey Blob fans!  In celebration of Valentine's Day this Sunday, we'd like to give out some codes for you to give to your very own Valentine!  Post your best in-game screenshot of A Boy and His Blob to the Community Screenshots using the Hug Button and tag it #BeMyValentine and we'll send you a code!  Unlike jelly-beans, we'll run out quick so be sure to make a post!  Codes will be distributed beginning Friday February 12, 2016 until we run out.  What are you waiting for?  Get hugging! ːBlobHugː:ːBlobHugːːBlobHugː

notes.title: A Boy And His Blob Bouncing Onto PC
notes.notes:
As magical childhood friends go, a wee alien blob which transforms into different objects when it eats jellybeans is a pretty good one. He’s the co-star of A Boy and His Blob [official site], WayForward’s re-imagining of ye olde A Boy and His Blob: Trouble on Blobolonia (cracking subtitle, that) from the NES in 1989. The adorable puzzle-platformer debuted on Wii back in 2009, and is only just making its way to PC now. All those jellybeans surely must slow one down. But come January 19th, it’ll be here.
